ADVISORY COMMISSION ON AGING AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 9, 2026
  1550 MARTIN LUTHER KING, JR. AVENUE
  ERNEST MCBRIDE PARK, 10:00 AM

Sylvia Salcedo, Vice Chair  Justin Potier, Commissioner
Norma Chinchilla, Commissioner  Phyllis Schmidt, Commissioner
Catherine Francis, Commissioner  Harold Sutherland, Commissioner

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-56050  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Advisory Commission on Aging
  meeting of Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-56054  Recommendation to review and approve Advisory Commission on Aging 2025
  Annual Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-56052  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the Ralph M. Brown Act and
  Robert’s Rules of Order from the Office of the City Attorney.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-56053  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the City of Long Beach’s
  2028 Olympic and Paralympics Games Planning.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-56051  Recommendation to receive and file Superintendent’s Update on department
  business.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
